legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish report or for furnishing inaccurate report under section 511.
legal_units.text: If any reporting entity referred to in section 511 fails to produce the information and documents within the period allowed under sub-section (7) of the said section, the prescribed authority under that section may impose on such entity, a penalty of Rs. 5000 for every day during which the failure continues, beginning from the day immediately following the day on which the period for furnishing the information and document expires.

Section 459(2): If any reporting entity referred to in section 511 fails to produce the information and documents within the period allowed under sub-section (7) of the said section, the prescribed authority under that section may impose on such entity, a penalty of Rs. 5000 for every day during which the failure continues, beginning from the day immediately following the day on which the period for furnishing the information and document expires.

legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish report or for furnishing inaccurate report under section 511.
legal_units.text: If the failure referred to in sub-section (1) or (2) continues after an order imposing a penalty under the said sub-section, has been served on the entity, then, irrespective of the provisions of the said sub-sections, the prescribed authority may impose penalty of fifty thousand rupees for every day for which such failure continues beginning from the date of service of such order.
